title: Yarn Stash Weight by Fiber
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:stash fiber_type=* stash_weight_g=*
| stats sum(stash_weight_g) as total_stash_weight_g by fiber_type
| sort - total_stash_weight_g
description: Adds up how much yarn weight is currently sitting in stash for each fiber family.
value: This tells you whether buying habits and project plans line up, especially when one fiber keeps multiplying.
implementation: Export stash entries with fiber type and remaining weight from Ravelry, then rank the totals by fiber.
visualization: Bar chart of total stash weight by fiber type.
grandmaExplanation: It watches what kinds of yarn you have the most of right now.
